entries.keyPattern: All Lead profiles are validated before commit. Any invalid row, duplicate business contact or authorization failure rejects the complete batch.
Asynchronous refund intent accepted by the backend. Provider completion/failure is backend-owned.
Atomically assign the Lead, reassign every declared open Task and create one handover Task. Any stale Task or authorization failure rolls back the complete workflow.
Authoritative allocation ledger outcome. Backend validates buyer, currency, outstanding receivable and available source balance.
Authoritative atomic Order batch mutation response.
Authoritative atomic Product batch mutation response.
Authoritative COD mutation outcome containing the current Payment Record projection.
Authoritative create/save Invoice draft mutation outcome. The backend assigns aggregate identifiers, version, timestamps, totals and audit evidence.
Authoritative credit-note creation response. Backend owns numbering, totals, receivable effects and audit evidence.
Authoritative Deal read projection. resourceVersion is the ETag/If-Match token and is distinct from configurable pipeline versions.
Authoritative manual-payment recording result. Backend assigns record and credit identifiers and owns ledger effects.
Authoritative Order read projection. Credit-policy evaluation is not approval evidence; an optional creditApproval summary is server-owned, version-bound and single-use.
Authoritative Payment Request delivery evidence response.
Authoritative Quote read projection. quoteRevision is business revision; resourceVersion is optimistic concurrency authority.
Authoritative workflow output. IDs and versions are server-assigned evidence; the frontend must not fabricate downstream records.
Backend checks Lead qualification permission plus downstream Quote/Order capability and module availability. No hidden Deal is created.
Backend-composed, permission-filtered Customer 360 projection. The frontend must not rebuild it through N+1 module queries.
Backend-owned price projection. Frontend must not treat local calculations as commercial authority.
Backend-owned Product availability projection for order eligibility.
Base-10 decimal string. Exponents and binary floating-point money are prohibited.
Cancellation request accepted. RefundIntent is not CANCELLED until the provider attempt acknowledges cancellation.
Client draft intent. Backend validates source Order eligibility and calculates all line/document totals using the canonical money policy.
Closed Product draft input. Backend owns identity, version, timestamps, archive evidence and pricing projection.
Closed Quote draft payload. Backend assigns quote identity, number, revision, totals, timestamps and resourceVersion and reprices every mutation using workspace financial rules.

Closed relationship-resolution intent. EXISTING requires selectedId. NEW CONTACT requires contact. NEW ORGANIZATION_ACCOUNT requires contact and organization. Identity matching, merge policy and authoritative IDs are backend-owned.
Command idempotency keys are intentionally excluded. Money remains decimal-string authoritative data.
Commercial input only. Line subtotal, discount result, tax amount, total, rounding and downstream document numbers are backend-owned.
correlationId is optional read evidence; absence must not be replaced with a server-like value by the frontend.
Creates a NEW Lead. IDs, timestamps, score, lifecycle state, audit metadata and activity records are server-owned.
Creates a Quote for the Deal in the path. Backend derives and validates buyer/source relationship from the Deal.
Đã tạo vai trò. Toàn bộ quyền vẫn có thể tùy chỉnh.
Decimal percentage from 0 through 100 inclusive. Backend owns rounding and calculated amounts.
Deprecated compatibility schema; no production operation references this schema.
Editable profile values are returned authoritatively; lifecycle, score, version, timestamps and activity projection remain server-owned.
Exactly one value field matching valueType must be present.
Full replacement of editable Lead profile fields. Omitted optional properties are cleared. Lifecycle, score, identity resolution and audit fields are not editable here.
grid gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_230px] sm:items-center
h-10 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-[10px] font-semibold outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100/70
Lead activities are intentionally excluded and must be loaded from a separate timeline/read-model contract.
Monotonic optimistic-concurrency version serialized through ETag/If-Match.
Mutable DRAFT fields only. Lifecycle, IDs, currency, source links, versions, totals and audit evidence are server-owned.
Only a CLOSED Lead with qualificationOutcome DISQUALIFIED may be reopened. The backend restores CONTACTING and clears disqualification evidence according to the canonical lifecycle rule.
Only accepted when targetWorkState is VERIFYING. Omitted fields remain unchanged.
OPPORTUNITY requires dealRef; other outcomes forbid dealRef
Permission-filtered Deal forecast projection grouped by currency. No cross-currency conversion is performed by the frontend.
Permission-filtered relationship projection owned by the Contacts backend boundary.
qualificationOutcome is only valid when leadWorkState=CLOSED
record is outside the active ${resourceKey} data scope.
References used to validate invoiceability. Backend must re-read the Order and may not trust client quantity or eligibility assertions.
Replaces the editable Quote draft profile and lines before repricing.
Requires either needSummary or at least one interestedProductId. Deal stage, score, timestamps, IDs and monetary calculations are backend-owned.
Retry request accepted. Backend creates a new server-assigned provider attempt linked to the failed predecessor.
Role created. All permissions remain customizable.
Server-evaluated credit-policy projection. It is not approval evidence and cannot authorize confirmation.
Server-issued line identifier. Omit for a new draft line.
Single-use, version-bound Order credit approval evidence. No wall-clock expiry is defined in P0.6; a binding change supersedes the approval.
Stable key scoped by workspace, operation and authenticated actor.
The backend atomically schedules the follow-up, advances NEW Leads to CONTACTING when allowed, and emits timeline evidence for every Lead.
The backend derives the owner from the authenticated actor and atomically claims the Lead; NEW Leads advance to CONTACTING.
The backend validates every transition and commits the batch atomically; no item may advance when any item fails.
The backend validates the canonical NEW -> CONTACTING -> VERIFYING progression and progressive profile requirements. CLOSED is not accepted.
unitPrice and costPrice are authoritative decimal-string Money. Numeric frontend fields are display-only projections.
